result.summary: `apps/console-web/plugins/app-tabs` (`ai.amberx.axf.console.app-tabs`). A tab bar across the whole page, one tab per AmberX app picked in Settings → Plugins → App tabs (default **Console + Pilot**). The console's tab is the console itself; any other tab covers the page below the bar with that app in
